item.title: RAH Reading at Home Program Launch
item.description:
The RAH (Reading At Home) program for grades K-2 begins Wednesday, September 30th, which is the first redemption day. Students record books read at home (books read to, by, or with child; 10 pages of chapter book = 1 book) and submit sheets with 20 books on Wednesdays for rewards alternating between books and prizes. Families can submit up to 2 completed sheets per week, and classrooms reading 1,000 books every 6 weeks receive a class reward.

item.title: Office Notes: Fees, Lunch Accounts, and Forms
item.description:
Student fees are available to pay online via Payschools Central or in the office with cash/check. Lunch accounts can be funded through Payschools Central; accounts reaching -$50 will be added to school fees. Apply for free or reduced lunch through the Kramer office or social worker Chelsea Pike—qualifying for free lunch waives all fees, while reduced lunch provides 85% fee reduction and free meals. Update any contact or address changes through Final Forms (address changes require new proof of residency submitted to the office).

item.title: Kramer Elementary No Toy Policy
item.description:
Kramer Elementary is implementing a NO TOY POLICY. Students should leave toys and other non-school-related items at home to keep classrooms focused, safe, and free from distractions. Exceptions will be made for medical needs supported by a note from a medical provider.

item.title: Health Education Curriculum Update - Erin's Law
item.description:
Ohio Senate Bill 288 (Erin's Law) requires updated health education curriculum on sexual abuse and sexual violence prevention for grades K-12. Instruction will occur October 12-26, 2026 and covers topics including social inclusion, dating violence/healthy relationships, and suicide prevention (curriculum links provided for each grade band). Parents may review the curriculum and opt out by October 7th using the provided form. Contact your student's school counselor with questions.
